customers_billing_name_check.name: customers_billing_name_check
customers_billing_name_check.value: "customers"."billing_name" is null or (char_length("customers"."billing_name") between 2 and 120 and "customers"."billing_name" !~ '[[:cntrl:]<>]')

customers_billing_address_check.name: customers_billing_address_check
customers_billing_address_check.value: "customers"."billing_address" is null or (char_length("customers"."billing_address") between 5 and 300 and "customers"."billing_address" !~ '[[:cntrl:]<>]')

kyc_submissions_review_check.name: kyc_submissions_review_check
kyc_submissions_review_check.value: "kyc_submissions"."status" = 'pending' OR ("kyc_submissions"."reviewer_id" IS NOT NULL AND "kyc_submissions"."reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL)

operations_unapproved_state_check.name: operations_unapproved_state_check
operations_unapproved_state_check.value: NOT "operations"."needs_approval" OR "operations"."approved_by" IS NOT NULL OR "operations"."state" IN ('needs_approval', 'failed')

notifications_recipient_check.name: notifications_recipient_check
notifications_recipient_check.value: "notifications"."customer_id" IS NOT NULL OR "notifications"."email" IS NOT NULL

support_requests_recipient_check.name: support_requests_recipient_check
support_requests_recipient_check.value: "support_requests"."customer_id" IS NOT NULL OR "support_requests"."email" IS NOT NULL

waitlist_entries_recipient_check.name: waitlist_entries_recipient_check
waitlist_entries_recipient_check.value: "waitlist_entries"."customer_id" IS NOT NULL OR "waitlist_entries"."email" IS NOT NULL
